Agent 18/35 — steady-state rear-steer contribution. Sweep 40–160 km/h constant-radius/constant-steer scenarios and isolate rear-steer effect on yaw gain, understeer gradient and tire slip. Check transition around 20 m/s for continuity and physically plausible same/opposite-phase behavior. Do not tune solely for agility. Any change must preserve low-speed maneuvering, high-speed stability and strict validation.
